build_HalideRewriter: build a HalideRewriter instance with term and operator vocabularies for expression simplification
run_alg_const_calculation: run algebraic constant folding on an expression tree node to simplify arithmetic operations
run_cmp_const_calculation: run comparison constant folding on an expression tree to simplify less than or equal checks
run_select_simplification: run select expression simplification to collapse conditional selects with constant conditions or equal branches
run_minmax_distribution: run min or max distribution over comparison operators to split into conjunctive or disjunctive forms
